description: This file defines the TermPartContentDriver class, which is responsible for displaying taxonomy term parts within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering content, querying related taxonomy items, and managing pagination.

classes.name: TermPartContentDriver
classes.description: A driver class for rendering and managing the display of TermPart content items within OrchardCore, including pagination and routing.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Overrides the base method to generate the display shape for a TermPart, including setting up pagination and route values.

methods.name: QueryTermItemsAsync
methods.description: Queries taxonomy items related to a specific TermPart, returning total count and list of content items.

methods.name: GetPagerAsync
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Pager object asynchronously based on user input and page size.
